explanations.key: e2e zz-theme-states.spec.ts > Account settings can return the theme to "Follow the system" (TH-004)
explanations.reason: Renamed and rewritten, not removed: the owner ruled (2026-11-28) that there are two themes only, light and dark, with one icon button that toggles them; there is no "Follow the system" state any more, so the test now checks that Account settings offer exactly Light and Dark, that each is remembered, and that a new person (an OS that prefers dark, an old stored "system") starts in light
explanations.newHome: e2e zz-theme-states.spec.ts > Account settings offer exactly Light and Dark, and a new person starts in light whatever the OS says (owner rule)

explanations.key: e2e wp21-editor-chrome.spec.ts > ${e.kind}: the shared header, Write by default with at least 55% of 1366x768, the palette, the shortcuts, focus mode and Esc
explanations.reason: Renamed, not removed: the owner-approved editor mockup (docs/audit/mockups/editor.html) opens with the explorer (248 px), the Properties panel (288 px) and the Problems panel (148 px) open, so the WP-21 first view with every panel closed and the document at 55% of 1366x768 is replaced by the mockup's (about 34% in the mockup itself; the test now asks 30% and checks that the three panels are open). Every other assertion is kept, focus mode still gives the page at least 70%
explanations.newHome: e2e wp21-editor-chrome.spec.ts > ${e.kind}: the shared header, Write by default with the mockup's panels open and at least 30% of 1366x768, the palette, the shortcuts, focus mode and Esc
explanations.decision: owner approved mockups 2026-11-28 (UI redesign): the default state must be the mockup's

explanations.key: toggle-side
explanations.reason: Moved, not removed: the S1000D page's single explorer toggle before the crumbs became the first of the three shared VS Code-style panel toggles of the top bar (explorer, Problems, Properties) in all three editors; the button keeps data-testid toggle-side, now given by the shared component (frontend/src/editors/host/ChromeControls.tsx PanelToggles, testId: 'toggle-side'), so the scanner no longer sees it as a JSX literal. Ctrl+Shift+B toggles it too
explanations.newHome: Editor top bar > Panels group > Explorer toggle (data-testid toggle-side, ChromeControls.tsx PanelToggles)
explanations.decision: owner's editor-chrome requests 2026-11-28 (panel toggles in the top bar, as VS Code)

explanations.newHome: Editor top bar > Quick preview (data-testid quick-preview-btn; Refresh on save = data-testid preview-autorefresh)
explanations.decision: owner's editor-chrome requests 2026-11-28 (S1000D Quick preview and Refresh in the top bar)

explanations.key: e2e doc-pages.spec.ts > unsaved work in the JSS and the JSG editor is not lost by clicking a tab either; Save and leave keeps it
explanations.reason: Phase 3 live co-editing made the editors save as they type (no draft, no PUT, no edit conflict); the classic save-by-version flow is now the fallback when the room cannot be joined (C24, AGASTYA_COLLAB=0). Split in two: the leave guard is tested on the classic fallback (joins answered DISABLED, e2e/support/live.ts) with every assertion kept; a new live test checks a tab click leaves at once and the text reaches the file
explanations.newHome: e2e doc-pages.spec.ts > unsaved work in the JSS and the JSG editor is not lost by clicking a tab either; Save and leave keeps it (classic) + live JSS and JSG editors: a tab click leaves without a question and what was typed is kept
